newsitem.title: UK: IEA sees first oil stock surplus for 18 months.
newsitem.headline: IEA sees first oil stock surplus for 18 months.

text.p: Oil inventories in the world's largest industrial nations recovered in January, ending the month higher than a year earlier for the first time in 18 months, the International Energy Agency said Friday.
The OECD's energy watchdog said stocks were drawn down by a modest 100,000 barrels per day in January, compared with a decline of one million barrels a day in January of 1996.

"As a result, total stocks ended the month higher than a year before for the first time since July 1995, with distillate stocks being 14 million barrels higher," the Paris-based agency said in its monthly Oil Market Report.
The IEA held to its forecast of world demand at 73.7 million barrels a day in 1997, up 1.9 million barrels.
